call_basis: Call rule (ROUTINE.md hard rule 6), judged at the Rs 245 upper band: Neutral value Rs 210 is 14.3% below (within 10-30%) and the Bull value Rs 253 is above the price, so the call is Neutral. At the Rs 232 floor the Neutral value is 9.5% below, which would read Subscribe. No material issue was found in the data available. Figures come from public trackers because the RHP was not read.
reference_note: Upper band Rs 245 (49,02,000 fresh shares, Rs 120.10 cr). At Rs 245: market cap Rs 400.3 cr post-issue; P/E 13.7x on FY26 PAT (9.6x pre-issue; 8.4x on the company's EPS of Rs 29.13); P/B about 2.0x post-issue; EV/EBITDA about 6.9x. One usable RHP peer P/E 16.1x. Objects floor Rs 213.
headline: An equipment-rental company (2,646 forklifts and reach trucks, 33 aerial work platforms, 25 states) with FY26 revenue of Rs 211 cr, a 31% EBITDA margin and 34% RoNW, raising Rs 120 cr of fresh money almost entirely for new fleet, priced at 13.7x FY26 earnings; fair value Rs 210 (Neutral) because fleet growth absorbs cash and leverage is high before the issue.
